item.title: ‘If we create trouble for Miyas, they’ll leave’: Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma’s remarks trigger controversy
item.description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma triggered a fresh political controversy after saying that “Miyas” would continue to face trouble in the state as long as he remains in power, claiming that creating pressure would force them to leave. His remarks, made at a government programme in Goalpara, drew sharp criticism from the opposition, which alleged misuse of electoral procedures and accused the BJP of targeting a particular community.

item.title: Tesla offers Rs 3 lakh exchange bonus to boost model Y sales in lndia
item.description: Tesla has introduced the “EV Switch & Save Program” for Indian buyers, offering an exchange bonus of Rs 300,000 on the Model Y Rear-Wheel Drive.
